cases.name: a killed resident waits out its cooldown
cases.description: Port 5642. The default is 30 minutes. Two chickens killed by their owner with protection off used to be back about 75 s later, an endless source of drops. Past the normal recovery delay they are still gone, nightfall does not put them inside (which would let them out in the morning) and Call back does nothing.

steps.name: wait: creative mode is on, which /clear needs
wait: the floor is down and the air is clear
wait: longer than the recovery delay and a sweep
wait: the house puts residents to bed
the row counts down, rounded up
press Call back as a stale page could
the page says it is recovering
wait: a call back would bring it out
